mod.appliedtiers.name: Applied Tiers
gui.appliedtiers.assembler_mode.title: Processing mode: %s
gui.appliedtiers.assembler_mode.automati: Accepts any supported plan in a free unit.
gui.appliedtiers.assembler_mode.exclusiv: While ME jobs are active, accepts only their shared encoded pattern.
Waiting for active ME jobs to reduce to one pattern identity.
gui.appliedtiers.assembler_mode.diversif: Accepts only encoded patterns different from every active ME job.
Existing duplicate jobs can finish. New duplicates wait until their earlier jobs return.
gui.appliedtiers.assembler_mode.standalo: Stored for ME dispatch. The installed pattern still runs in all units.
